evidenceClasses.appendix-b-quality-rule: A replay of the paper's Medium or High GSP-Spec quality criteria.
evidenceClasses.bounded-compatibility: A candidate historical compatibility statement that permits alternatives and makes no birth-origin claim.
evidenceClasses.bounded-selection: A deterministic 64-source projection from exact Gaia DR3 queries.
evidenceClasses.deterministic-rule-membership: Onto2D application of an explicit chemo-kinematic rule, not a native Gaia label.
evidenceClasses.explicit-non-claim: A boundary preventing origin, ancestry, causality, or Historical Load promotion.
evidenceClasses.gaia-apsis-estimate: A GSP-Spec parameter estimate with 16th/84th percentile bounds.
evidenceClasses.gaia-catalogue-observation: A Gaia source catalogue quantity with its reported measurement uncertainty.
evidenceClasses.published-companion-derived: An orbit or action estimate in the chemical-cartography companion table.
